curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain why motorcycles are hard to see and judge, the full-lane rule, why riders change position, and the helmet, license and visibility rules for riders.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; a contrast card for never sharing a lane versus giving a full lane when passing.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on driving near motorcycles.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the size of large vehicles, not cutting in front, the mirror test and the No-Zone, not riding alongside or tailgating, and how to finish a pass.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; a contrast card for the mirror test and the No-Zone.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on where to be around a truck.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach truck lanes on grades and near weigh stations, hazmat stops at crossings, wide right turns, stopping distances, slow acceleration and misjudging truck speed.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each truck behavior; a contrast card for car and truck stopping distances.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on predicting what a truck will do.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the pedestrian's duties at signals, mid-block and on roads without sidewalks, then the driver's duties to yield, not pass stopped cars, school zones, blind pedestrians, crosswalks and right turns.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each pedestrian and driver rule; contrast cards for green-light yielding and blind pedestrians.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on who yields in pedestrian scenarios.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach where bike crashes happen, turning near cyclists, passing with a full lane, bike lanes and doors, then the riders' rights, lane position and street riding.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards for lane position on two-way and one-way streets.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on driving and riding near bicycles.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover where mopeds may not go, licenses and helmets, passing room for riders, required equipment, brakes and the lighting and reflector distances.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; a contrast card for the four lighting distances.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on moped and bicycle equipment.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain what counts as an electric bicycle and its three classes, then what counts as a motorized bicycle such as a moped.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each definition; contrast cards for the electric bicycle classes.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach funeral procession rules, what road rage is and how to respond and report it, reporting a drunk driver, and the littering penalty.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards for procession right-of-way and the two reporting rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on procession, road rage and reporting scenarios.
